'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Attacks on religious sites during the Israeli invasion of Gaza]]
***Three people are killed and nine others are injured when [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] strikes the [[Holy Family Church, Gaza|Holy Family Church]] in [[Gaza City]], the only [[Catholicism|Catholic church]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8xvnlpx2dxo (BBC News)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**At least six people are killed and ten others are injured after a fresh outbreak of tribal violence in the [[Galgaduud]] region of [[Somalia]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/July/202237/clan_clashes_kill_six_injure_dozens_in_galgaduud.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Kut shopping mall fire]]
**At least 69 people are killed, 11 are reported missing, and 43 others are injured in a fire at a shopping mall in [[Kut]], [[Wasit Governorate]], [[Iraq]]. The [[Iraqi government]] declares three days of mourning and the provincial government files [[lawsuit]]s against the owners of the mall. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/fire-iraq-mall-kills-69-prime-minister-orders-probe-2025-07-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/17/middleeast/iraq-kut-building-deadly-fire-intl-hnk?cid=external-feeds_iluminar_google (CNN)] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/50-killed-many-injured-as-huge-fire-breaks-out-at-shopping-mall-in-iraq-8891556 (NDTV)]
*At least four people are killed, two others are seriously injured and more than 1,000 others are evacuated after torrential rainfall submerges buildings and causes a [[landslide]] in [[Gyeonggi]] and [[South Chungcheong]] provinces, [[South Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/south-korea-lashed-by-heavy-rain-four-dead-more-than-1000-evacuated-2025-07-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10533928 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*A child is killed and 21 people are injured when a [[coach (bus)|coach bus]] crashes in [[Somerset]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg538x0lm5o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Verkhovna Rada|parliament]] appoints [[Yulia Svyrydenko]] as the new [[Prime Minister of Ukraine|prime minister]], succeeding [[Denys Shmyhal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/en/ukraine-appoints-new-prime-minister-biggest-wartime-overhaul-2025-07-17/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announces it will lower the [[voting age]] to 16, allowing 16- and 17-year-olds to vote in the [[next United Kingdom general election|upcoming general election]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/07/17/nx-s1-5471304/uk-lowers-voting-age-16 (NPR)]
